This is a real concern - the database is updated with new guests, but if email notification fails, users won't know. However, this is a design decision rather than a bug - the guests ARE successfully added to the booking (the primary operation succeeds), and the email is a secondary notification. Many systems intentionally don't fail the primary operation due to email failures. This is an important architectural concern but not strictly a bug since the core functionality (adding guests) works correctly.
